final: WITH per_op AS (SELECT crewref, COUNT(*) AS n_scans, AVG(CASE WHEN gbsize IS NOT NULL AND spanmin IS NOT NULL AND spanmin <> 0 THEN gbsize / spanmin END) AS avg_gbpm FROM scans GROUP BY crewref), valid AS (SELECT * FROM per_op WHERE avg_gbpm IS NOT NULL), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_gbpm) AS m FROM valid) SELECT AVG(n_scans) AS avg_num_scans, AVG(avg_gbpm) AS avg_gb_per_min, AVG(avg_gbpm - (SELECT m FROM overall)) AS avg_margin_above_overall FROM valid WHERE avg_gbpm > (SELECT m FROM overall)
